heard: A black hole has jets that dance. These plasma beams blast out at half the speed of light. Sounding rockets first spotted this strange x-ray source in 1964. It was history's first confirmed black hole. Cygnus X-1 is locked in a tight orbit with a supergiant star. It's actively tearing superheated gas away from its companion. Stephen Hawking even bet against it being a black hole. Massive stellar winds batter the jets into a wobble. That's why a black hole has jets that dance.
